ITEM 1 | Large mound of white, crumbly, granular curds with soft, slightly moist surface and fine loose texture, piled in a heap covering roughly 40% of the plate, about 5 cm tall at the center, sitting on top of the plate's upper half and partially overlapping the fruit and vegetable cubes | 230
ITEM 2 | Bright red cubes with smooth, slightly glossy, juicy-looking surfaces, cut into roughly 2.5 cm irregular chunks, lying in a cluster on the lower-left part of the plate, about 1.5 cm tall, partly covered by the white crumbly mound | 150
ITEM 3 | Orange-brown cubes with slightly caramelized, darker edges and a firm, dense surface, cut into roughly 2 cm pieces, arranged in a cluster on the lower-right part of the plate, about 1.5 to 2 cm tall, next to the red cubes and partly under the white mound | 130
